text: The current OAuth setup test starts local IMAP, SMTP and OAuth servers, arms promiseOAuthWindow before Continue, and submits only test_mail scope to skip CardDAV/CalDAV discovery. It then asserts OAuth2 on the created account and a success view with zero discovered services. These controlled fixture assertions do not prove production provider behavior or the broader discovery flow. This is source and test-code inspection. Complete Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.
title: OAuth account tests control authorization scope as well as the popup
